state.project: DU: Dawson Crossing - Nelson (White) 115 kV Rebuild
state.description: Rebuild approximately 15.7 miles of the Dawson Crossing - Etowah - Reavis Mountain - Nelson sections of the Dawson Crossing - Nelson (White) 115kV line with 1351 ACSS conductor. GPC will make any necessary relaying changes at Dawson Crossing.

q.instructions: Is this town a fair approximate location for the endpoint?

criteria.true: The endpoint is named after this town (e.g. 'Bluffton' substation near Bluffton, SC).
criteria.false: The name only shares a word with the town or clearly refers to something elsewhere (e.g. 'Union Pier' is not Union, SC).
